task.title: Streaming workshop aggregate
task.summary_zh: 依 SD §17.2(workshops/{id}/stream)與 §8.3 串接 workshop SSE aggregate:把 message ack、completeness 更新、research progress、version 事件以 streaming 聚合推給前端;首個 acknowledgement < 2s,長任務走 progress。沿用 AG-BE-ID-003 的 SSE 機制與 §8.2 audit 欄位,OpenClaw 降級回 OPENCLAW_UPSTREAM_DEGRADED。
acceptance: workshop stream 以 SSE 聚合推 completeness/progress/version 事件;首 ack < 2s;斷線可重連;事件帶 trace/audit;附整合測試;【驗收】實作與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致,無自創欄位/route/enum;遇疑問須先開 blocker 澄清而非自行實作;自行臆測或偏離設計稿一律不通過

blockers.message: Blocked before implementation: the task asks for /bff/agora/workshops/{id}/stream to aggregate message ack, completeness updates, research progress, and version events, but the referenced schemas/OpenAPI only define a generic SSE text stream of strategy_workshop_event rows. No canonical event names/payload fields exist for message ack vs completeness vs research progress vs version updates; research-runs and versions endpoints are still 501 in agora/strategy_workshop/router.py, so there is no specified upstream progress source to stream; OPENCLAW_UPSTREAM_DEGRADED is named in the task but is not present in the BFF ErrorCode/AgoraErrorCode or Agora v1.2 error contracts. Per task brief, do not invent schema/event fields or degraded code; need reviewer/spec clarification before coding.
